events.verdict: Alvarado (NOP) places both hands to Tatum's (BOS) body as both players come together during the rebound and does not extend his arms as Alvarado releases in pursuit of the loose ball. The contact that occurs is marginal.
Holiday (BOS) moves alongside McCollum's (NOP) path as both players come together at the start of the drive, which is marginal.
McCollum (NOP) briefly loses control of the ball as he attempts to gather and then legally recovers prior to releasing the pass.
White (BOS) has a resting forearm on Murphy III's (NOP) body as he drives toward the basket, and marginal contact occurs before White removes his arm during Murphy III's upward shooting motion.
Missi (NOP) grasps and then quickly releases Porzingis's (BOS) jersey off-ball.
Green (NOP) puts his hand through the net and makes contact with the ball while it's in the imaginary cylinder as the called illegal contact occurs with Porzingis (BOS) during his play at the basket.
Green (NOP) jumps from point A to point B and makes contact with Porzingis' (BOS) arm, which affects his shot attempt at the basket.
Green (NOP) establishes a screening position in Holiday's (BOS) path and absorbs the incoming contact as the pick occurs.
McCollum (NOP) does not bring his off-hand to the ball before continuing his dribble.
Murphy III (NOP) maintains his pivot prior to releasing the jump shot attempt.
White (BOS) legally contests Murphy III's (NOP) jump shot attempt.
Murphy III's (NOP) shot attempt does not come into contact with the rim as the shot clock expires. Possession is correctly awarded to BOS.
Tatum (BOS) and Green (NOP) engage and disengage as both players come together off-ball as the contact that occurs is marginal.
Alvarado (NOP) makes clean contact to the ball as he attempts to dislodge it away from Tatum (BOS).
Alvarado (NOP) reaches around Brown (BOS) and grazes his arm, which is marginal as Brown maintains control of the ball during the drive.
McCollum (NOP) gathers the ball on his right foot and takes two steps before his jump shot attempt.
White (BOS) legally contests McCollum's (NOP) shot attempt.
Tatum (BOS) gathers the pass on his right foot and takes two steps before coming to a stop.
McCollum (NOP) briefly grasps Tatum's (BOS) jersey and releases it at the start of his drive, which is marginal as Tatum is able to move through the contact.
McCollum (NOP) legally contests Tatum's (BOS) jump shot attempt.
